item.title: Connect to Your In Demand Email Account
item.description: How to set up your device for email: > Click here and look at the "Topics" section for instructions relevant to your email program / device. Or generic setup instructions... Add a new email account to your computer/device: On a laptop or desktop mac, open Mac Mail, go to the MAIL menu and choose Add account... On an iPhone (iOS 11), open Settings, select Accounts & Passwords and then select Add Account (near the bottom).
